title: Craftable Totem
description: Add the craft of the Totem Of Undying !
body:
![Craft Totem Of Undying](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/r7y1Wn90/images/5f9bd509c32e86a9f4b2084c93bf4eaa94da439b.jpeg)

🛡️ Craftable Totem of Undying

Are you tired of hunting down Woodland Mansions or setting up complex raid farms just to get a second chance at life? This datapack introduces a balanced and rewarding way to craft the Totem of Undying directly from your crafting table.
✨ Features

    Survival Balanced: Designed to feel like a natural part of the game. The recipe requires valuable materials to ensure the Totem remains a high-tier endgame item.

    Vanilla Experience: No mods or complex commands required. It integrates seamlessly into any survival world or SMP.

    Server Friendly: Extremely lightweight code that won't impact your server's performance (TPS).

🛠️ How to find the recipe?

To keep the discovery part of the game alive, the recipe isn't listed here. You can find it in-game by:

    Checking your Recipe Book once you have gathered the required materials.

    Using a recipe viewer mod like EMI, REI, or JEI.

🚀 Installation

    Download the .zip file.

    Drop it into the datapacks folder of your world save.

    Run the /reload command in-game.
